entries.name: IfcOpenShell
entries.description: Open-source toolkit and geometry engine for BuildingSMART IFC files. Enables reading, writing, and modifying BIM models via a C++ library and Python API.

entries.name: xBIM Toolkit
entries.description: The eXtensible BIM Toolkit for .NET, providing libraries to work with IFC data (read, create, validate). Allows developers on the Microsoft stack to build BIM applications.

entries.name: BIMserver
entries.description: Open-source BIM server platform (Java) that stores and manages building models using IFC. Acts as a model database with versioning and multi-user collaboration.

entries.name: IFC.js
entries.description: JavaScript toolkit (WASM-powered) for bringing IFC BIM data into web applications. Includes `web-ifc` for fast parsing and `web-ifc-three` for viewing in Three.js.

entries.name: That Open Engine Fragments
entries.description: High-performance 3D engine for efficiently handling massive amounts of BIM data using the Fragments format.

entries.name: That Open UI Components
entries.description: Collection of web components designed for Building Information Modeling (BIM) applications.

entries.name: Speckle
entries.description: Open-source AEC data platform ("Git for BIM") that enables real-time collaboration and interoperability by streaming geometry and data between design tools.

entries.name: BHoM (Buildings and Habitats object Model)
entries.description: A collaborative computational framework and data schema for the built environment. Defines a core object model for AEC domains (structure, environment, MEP, etc.).

entries.name: Revit SDK Samples
entries.description: Revit SDK documentation and samples demonstrating Revit API usage for automation and plugin development, maintained by Autodesk's Jeremy Tammik.

entries.name: BIMsurfer
entries.description: Web-based BIM viewer for IFC models with clash detection and collaboration features.

entries.name: GomeraX
entries.description: Experimental IFC viewer with AI-powered BIM assistant. Features WebGL and WebGPU rendering, advanced sectioning, first-person navigation, element clustering, and natural language commands for model interaction via local LLM.

entries.name: dotBIM (.bim)
entries.description: Minimalist file format for BIM.

entries.name: xeokit convert
entries.description: Convert BIM and AEC models directly into XKT files with JavaScript for super fast loading into xeokit.

entries.name: xeokit BIM Viewer
entries.description: Bundled BIM Viewer built on top of xeokit SDK with features like measurements, tree view explorer, annotations, slicing, first-person navigation.

entries.name: xeokit SDK
entries.description: Productive open-source JavaScript SDK and 3D engine with its own WebGL renderer and extensive library of feature examples for viewing BIM, IFC, BCF, Revit, Point Clouds and other with real-world coordinates and double precision with XKT format.

entries.name: IFClite
entries.description: Open-source toolkit for working with IFC files in the browser, on a server, or in a desktop app. Features a WebGPU 3D viewer, IFC4/IFC4X3 support, BCF collaboration, IDS compliance checking, bSDD lookup, 2D drawing generation, and export to IFC, glTF, CSV, JSON, and Parquet.

entries.name: goifc
entries.description: Pure-Go, cgo-free IFC reader: parses STEP, walks the spatial and semantic model, tessellates geometry, and labels every quantity with where it came from (authored Qto or derived from geometry). Geometry bounds are checked against IfcOpenShell on public sample models.

entries.name: Massing
entries.description: Open, self-hosted, IFC-native AEC platform spanning acquisition through turnover on a single model. Browser-based IFC authoring on That Open Fragments and IfcOpenShell, federated clash detection, IDS validation, BCF round-trip, generated 2D plans, sections and elevations, a ~100-module general contracting portal with RFIs, pay apps and CPM scheduling, and a development proforma with JV waterfall.

entries.name: BIM Guard
entries.description: Open-source BIM compliance application with a FastAPI backend and Svelte frontend. Upload IFC models, extract compliance rules from regulatory documents, validate against buildingSMART IDS and ISO 19650 naming, and generate reports with BCF issues.

entries.name: OpenSKP
entries.description: Open-source toolkit for reading, writing, and converting SketchUp (`.skp`) files in five languages, with exports including GLB, OBJ, STL, PLY, DXF, IFC4, and Fragments.

entries.name: AEC Open Source Directory
entries.description: Curated directory of open-source projects for architecture, engineering, and construction, with a browsable live frontend.

entries.name: Voxelization Toolkit
entries.description: Toolkit for analyzing IFC building models with voxel-based geometry, including volume calculations, evacuation-distance analysis, and building-code checks.

entries.name: IFC Flow Map
entries.description: Visual, node-based tool for viewing, filtering, transforming, analyzing, and exporting IFC building data.

entries.name: IFC Classifier
entries.description: Browser-based tool for viewing IFC models and assigning, managing, and exporting element classifications.

entries.name: HoneyIFC
entries.description: Desktop application for browsing IFC 2x3 and IFC4 model data and exporting structured data to spreadsheets.

entries.name: BIM Open Schema
entries.description: Open specification for BIM data, including geometry, stored in compact Parquet-based files for data exchange and analysis.

entries.name: Ara 3D WebGL
entries.description: WebGL viewer for large building and infrastructure models represented as BIM Open Schema files.

entries.name: Open BIM Components
entries.description: Collection of Three.js-based tools for building browser-based BIM applications, including model processing, floor-plan navigation, and DXF export.

entries.name: Speckle2Graph
entries.description: Python library that converts Revit and IFC models from Speckle into Neo4j graphs while preserving model relationships and hierarchies.

entries.name: GeometryGymIFC
entries.description: C# classes for generating and parsing IFC files, supporting IFC2x3, IFC4 and infrastructure extensions such as IFC4.3.

entries.name: Information Delivery Specification (IDS)
entries.description: buildingSMART XML-based standard for defining IFC information delivery requirements, with the schema, examples and documentation.

entries.name: buildingSMART Data Dictionary
entries.description: Repository and documentation for the bSDD, an online service hosting classifications, properties, allowed values and units for the built environment.

entries.name: Elements
entries.description: Open-source C# library for building BIM applications, with a geometry kernel and core building element types.

entries.name: 3D House Planner
entries.description: Free browser-based 2D/3D floor planner for houses and apartments with a furniture catalog, IFC import and export to IFC, GLB, OBJ, STL, DXF, SVG and PNG.

entries.name: IFC Checker
entries.description: Browser-based checker that tests IFC models against buildingSMART IDS requirements, shows the results in tables with only the failing values marked, and turns selected results into BCF issues. Includes an IDS editor.

entries.name: BIMpedia
entries.description: Free browser tools for BIM coordination and information management (BEP, MIDP, LOD/LOIN, IDS, clash matrices, BCF, COBie checks), with plain-language lessons and an ISO 19650 reference. Exports to Excel, PDF and Word; no sign-up.

entries.name: FreeCAD
entries.description: Free, open-source parametric 3D CAD modeler with a modular architecture. Includes an Arch Workbench for BIM and supports exporting to IFC, DWG, and STEP.

entries.name: LibreCAD
entries.description: Open-source 2D CAD drawing tool based on QCAD's community edition. Provides a cross-platform GUI for drafting with DXF/DWG support.

entries.name: BRL-CAD
entries.description: Mature open-source solid modeling system featuring a powerful CSG geometry engine and high-performance ray tracing.

entries.name: OpenSCAD
entries.description: "The Programmer's Solid 3D CAD Modeller." Users create 3D models by writing scripts that define primitives and boolean operations.

entries.name: SolveSpace
entries.description: A lightweight, parametric 2D/3D CAD program supporting constraint-based sketching and exports to STEP/DXF/STL.

entries.name: CadQuery
entries.description: Python-based parametric CAD scripting framework for mechanical and architectural design.

entries.name: ArchLang
entries.description: Open-source (MIT) DSL for floor plans that compiles `.arch` source to SVG, DXF and PDF with linting and geometric validation, and reads a plan back as rooms, areas, adjacency and an access graph without rendering an image.

entries.name: Prompt2CAD
entries.description: Browser-based AI CAD workspace that turns natural-language requirements into dimensioned 3D models for physical objects. Useful for early AECO components, interior fixtures, furniture, and fabrication-ready concepts with STEP, DXF, STL, OBJ, and GLB export.

entries.name: conversion-tables
entries.description: Exact unit conversion factors, architectural and engineering drawing scale factors, and fractional inch tables as JSON and CSV. Values derive from the legal definitions (inch, pound, US and imperial gallon) rather than being transcribed, and exact definitions are kept separate from approximate conventions. No runtime or dependencies.

entries.name: Open CASCADE Technology
entries.description: C++ platform for developing 3D surface and solid modeling, CAD data exchange, visualization, manufacturing, and numerical simulation software.

entries.name: rhino3dm
entries.description: Libraries for creating, inspecting, and exchanging Rhino geometry in .NET, Python, and JavaScript applications without requiring Rhino.

entries.name: Pascal Editor
entries.description: Open-source, local-first 3D building editor built with React Three Fiber and WebGPU. Runs in the browser or from the CLI, and connects AI agents through MCP.

entries.name: Open CAD Studio
entries.description: Open-source 2D drafting and 3D modeling application for desktop and web, built with Rust, with DWG and DXF support.

entries.name: LibreDWG
entries.description: GNU C library for reading and writing the DWG file format used by AutoCAD.

entries.name: ACadSharp
entries.description: C# library for reading and writing DXF and DWG files in .NET applications.

entries.name: QCAD
entries.description: Open-source 2D CAD application for technical drawings and plans, with DXF support.

entries.name: House Planner
entries.description: Self-hosted web planner for a private house with a true-scale 2D plan, 3D view, site overlay, utility layouts, design checks and a bill of materials.

entries.name: Room Meadow
entries.description: Browser-based 2D floor plan editor for drawing measured rooms, placing doors and furniture, and checking clearances. Drawing and watermarked PNG export are free without an account, and print-to-scale PDF export uses credits.

entries.name: pyRevit
entries.description: A rapid-development environment for Autodesk Revit. Lets users create custom tools in IronPython or CPython with an extensive API.

entries.name: RevitLookup
entries.description: Interactive BIM database explorer for Revit. Inspects data of selected elements (parameters, properties) in real-time.

entries.name: Rhino.Inside Revit
entries.description: Embeds McNeel Rhino 3D and Grasshopper into Revit's environment, enabling seamless transfer of geometry and parameters.

entries.name: IFC Exporter for Revit
entries.description: The open-source IFC plugin used by Revit for improved IFC support (IFC2x3/IFC4).

entries.name: Revit Add-in Manager
entries.description: Revit utility for loading, running, and debugging add-ins without restarting the application.

entries.name: Bowerbird
entries.description: Revit 2025 plugin that dynamically compiles and reloads C# command files for add-in development.

entries.name: sPrint
entries.description: Chrome extension for batch-printing PDFs and downloading derivatives from Autodesk BIM 360 and Autodesk Construction Cloud.

entries.name: Revit Database Explorer
entries.description: Revit add-in for exploring the Revit database, with the ability to edit parameter values, query elements, run ad hoc C# scripts and visualize element geometry.

entries.name: Revit Toolkit
entries.description: Library providing a modern interface to the Revit API for add-in development in .NET.

entries.name: Revit Templates
entries.description: Project templates for creating Revit add-ins on .NET, with multi-target support for Revit API versions.

entries.name: Model MCP
entries.description: Open-source MCP server for Autodesk Revit 2022 to 2027: read, audit and edit live models with 89 tools, one Undo entry per change, and a workstation read-only lock.

entries.name: RayCAD
entries.description: Revit plugin that automates MEPF tagging and annotation of shop drawings, placing consistent, non-overlapping tags that follow a firm's own standard. HVAC and piping today; Revit 2021 to 2027.

entries.name: RST
entries.description: Revit add-in for building ribbon tabs from Revit's own commands and the commands of other add-ins, saved as profiles that a BIM manager can share and users load in one click. Supports Revit 2025 to 2027.

entries.name: Gantt-It
entries.description: Revit add-in that draws Gantt charts as native Revit legends in the project's own graphic styles, ready to place on sheets and regenerate when the schedule changes. Supports Revit 2025 to 2027.

entries.name: Splash-It
entries.description: Revit add-in that colors view tabs by the file they belong to and regroups scattered tabs, with separate palettes for project and family files. Supports Revit 2025 to 2027.

entries.name: Drive It
entries.description: Open-source MCP server and add-in for Autodesk Revit 2026 that lets MCP clients such as Claude and Codex work in the open Revit session, with a chosen workspace folder, one-time approval for anything outside it, and a receipt for every run. Early alpha.

entries.name: zexus
entries.description: Autodesk Revit AI agent and add-in combining an MCP server with dynamic C# execution against the Revit API.

entries.name: EnergyPlus
entries.description: The DOE's flagship whole-building energy simulation engine. Models heating/cooling loads, HVAC systems, and energy consumption.

entries.name: OpenStudio
entries.description: A cross-platform collection of tools for whole-building energy modeling that sits on top of EnergyPlus.

entries.name: Ladybug Tools
entries.description: Suite of open-source environmental analysis tools connecting CAD modeling to physics engines (e.g., Ladybug for solar analysis, Honeybee for energy/daylight).

entries.name: Radiance
entries.description: Industry-standard lighting simulation suite for evaluating daylight and electric lighting, producing accurate luminance values.

entries.name: OpenFOAM
entries.description: Computational fluid dynamics (CFD) toolkit for airflow and thermal simulations.

entries.name: OpenSees
entries.description: Open System for Earthquake Engineering Simulation. Framework for structural FEA and seismic simulation of structures.

entries.name: HVACLogic
entries.description: Deterministic, 100% client-side engineering calculation suite for building science, duct aerodynamics, cooling loads, and heat pump sizing.

entries.name: bim2sim
entries.description: Python library that maps IFC BIM data into simulation models for building performance and HVAC, with basic methods for CFD and life-cycle assessment.

entries.name: honeybee-energy
entries.description: Honeybee extension for defining building energy properties and translating building models for EnergyPlus and OpenStudio simulation.

entries.name: Dragonfly Core
entries.description: Python libraries for creating and editing large-scale building models using the Dragonfly schema, with extensions for environmental simulation.

entries.name: honeybee-radiance
entries.description: Honeybee extension for daylight and radiation simulation with Radiance.

entries.name: Awatif
entries.description: Browser-based structural analysis and design toolset with finite-element analysis, Eurocode checks, and report generation.

entries.name: Pynite
entries.description: Python library for elastic 3D structural finite element analysis.

entries.name: anaStruct
entries.description: Python library for analyzing 2D frames and trusses, computing bending moments, shear and axial forces, and displacements.

entries.name: XC
entries.description: Open-source finite element analysis program for civil engineering structures, with Python scripting.

entries.name: Sinergym
entries.description: Gymnasium-based interface to building simulation engines such as EnergyPlus, for testing reinforcement learning and custom controllers on building models.

entries.name: OpenDSM
entries.description: Python library, formerly OpenEEmeter, for calculating metered energy savings in buildings.

entries.name: EngineeringPaper.xyz
entries.description: Web app for engineering calculations with automatic unit checking, plotting and equation solving, run locally in the browser.

entries.name: CalculiX
entries.description: Free finite element program for linear and nonlinear structural, dynamic and thermal analysis, with Abaqus-compatible input.

entries.name: Code_Aster
entries.description: Open-source finite element solver from EDF for structural mechanics, thermomechanics and nonlinear analysis.

entries.name: OpenGeoSys
entries.description: Open-source multiphysics simulator for thermo-hydro-mechanical-chemical processes in porous and fractured media.

entries.name: OpenSeesPy
entries.description: Python interface to the OpenSees structural and geotechnical simulation framework.

entries.name: sectionproperties
entries.description: Python package for analyzing arbitrary structural cross-sections, computing section properties, warping and stresses.

entries.name: OpenQuake Engine
entries.description: Seismic hazard and risk analysis engine from the Global Earthquake Model Foundation.

entries.name: GeoEq
entries.description: Python workflow for onshore geotechnical analysis, including soil classification, SPT and CPT interpretation, foundation design and liquefaction.

entries.name: groundhog
entries.description: Python library for geotechnical engineering covering site investigation data, foundation design and soil profile analysis.

entries.name: geolysis
entries.description: Python package for geotechnical analysis, including soil classification, SPT corrections and bearing capacity.

entries.name: pygef
entries.description: Python parser and analysis tools for CPT and borehole files (GEF and XML) from geotechnical site investigations.

entries.name: SUMO
entries.description: Microscopic multi-modal traffic simulation package for modeling urban and highway networks.

entries.name: MATSim
entries.description: Agent-based framework for large-scale transport simulation and travel demand modeling.

entries.name: AequilibraE
entries.description: Python package for transportation modeling, with network editing, traffic assignment and a QGIS plugin.

entries.name: EPA SWMM
entries.description: EPA's Storm Water Management Model for simulating runoff, stormwater, wastewater and combined sewer systems.

entries.name: PySWMM
entries.description: Python interface to EPA SWMM for stepping through stormwater simulations and controlling hydraulic elements.

entries.name: EPANET
entries.description: Hydraulic and water quality solver for pressurized water distribution networks.

entries.name: WNTR
entries.description: Python package from the EPA for simulating and analyzing the resilience of water distribution networks.

entries.name: MODFLOW 6
entries.description: USGS modular hydrologic model for simulating groundwater flow and transport.

entries.name: FloPy
entries.description: Python package for creating, running and post-processing MODFLOW-based groundwater models.

entries.name: HEC-RAS
entries.description: Free river hydraulic modeling software from the US Army Corps of Engineers.

entries.name: HEC-HMS
entries.description: Free hydrologic modeling software from the US Army Corps of Engineers.

entries.name: QSDsan
entries.description: Python package for quantitative sustainable design of sanitation and resource recovery systems, with process modeling and life cycle assessment.

entries.name: Engineering on Web FEA
entries.description: Free browser-based finite element solver for 2D and 3D structural, thermal, fluid and electromagnetic problems, including coupled physics, with WebGPU acceleration and a CPU fallback.

entries.name: AgentFEM
entries.description: Python finite-element platform for structural and thermal analysis, with editable models, command-line workflows and result verification for engineering studies. Runs locally on FEniCSx and can be operated by compatible AI agents.

entries.name: EPW.tools
entries.description: Web service, API and MCP server that generates EnergyPlus weather files (EPW, DDY, STAT) and ASHRAE design conditions for any coordinates: actual years from 1990, typical years and future climate to 2100.

entries.name: Calc
entries.description: Revit-based workflow for assessing the environmental impact of early building designs using material assemblies and life-cycle calculations.

entries.name: IfcLCA
entries.description: Open-source application that analyzes building life-cycle impacts from IFC models using environmental impact data and exports results back into IFC.

entries.name: LCAx
entries.description: Open data format and validator for exchanging life-cycle assessment results, environmental product declarations, and assemblies.

entries.name: openLCA
entries.description: Open-source life cycle assessment and footprint software.

entries.name: Brightway
entries.description: Open-source Python framework for life cycle inventory and environmental impact assessment.

entries.name: Construction R-value Calculator
entries.description: Browser-based calculator for construction R-values of walls, roofs and floors to New Zealand's H1/AS1 6th edition, using the NZS 4214 isothermal planes method and the Appendix E slab-on-ground tables. Shows every calculation step and a section drawing, and exports a PDF report.

entries.name: Dynamo
entries.description: Open-source visual programming platform for design automation. Popular for generative design and automating repetitive tasks in BIM.

entries.name: COMPAS
entries.description: Python-based computational framework for architecture, engineering, and digital fabrication.

entries.name: Rhino.Compute
entries.description: REST geometry server based on the Rhino 3D geometry kernel. Allows programmatic, headless access to Rhino's modeling capabilities.

entries.name: Bonsai (formerly BlenderBIM)
entries.description: Blender add-on for BIM workflows, supporting IFC import/export and parametric modeling.

entries.name: Polygonjs
entries.description: Node-based WebGL design tool for creating interactive 3D experiences and digital twins without coding.

entries.name: COMPAS Wood
entries.description: COMPAS-based tools for generating timber joints and working with timber fabrication geometry.

entries.name: Geospiza
entries.description: .NET library and Grasshopper plugin for evolutionary algorithms in architectural and engineering design.

entries.name: D2P Components
entries.description: Grasshopper plugin for organizing parametric building components, their properties, instances, and parent-child relationships.

entries.name: HYWE
entries.description: Open computational design environment for generating and analyzing early-stage architectural layouts and massing from spatial programs and constraints.

entries.name: Cordyceps
entries.description: Model Context Protocol server for Rhino 8 and Grasshopper that lets AI agents place, wire and group Grasshopper components and manage Rhino layers and geometry.

entries.name: Home Assistant
entries.description: Platform for smart home automation and IoT device integration with a focus on local control and privacy.

entries.name: openHAB
entries.description: Vendor-agnostic open-source software for integrating and controlling smart building devices.

entries.name: Eclipse VOLTTRON
entries.description: Platform for distributed sensing and control of building systems. Provides services to collect real-time data from building equipment.

entries.name: EdgeX Foundry
entries.description: Modular IoT platform for managing sensors and data in smart buildings.

entries.name: ThingsBoard
entries.description: Open-source IoT platform for device management, data visualization, and analytics.

entries.name: Google Digital Buildings
entries.description: Uniform schema and toolset for representing structured information about buildings and their installed equipment.

entries.name: Brick Schema
entries.description: Open-source uniform metadata schema for efficiently representing metadata in buildings.

entries.name: Condo
entries.description: Open-source property management SaaS for tracking maintenance tickets, resident contacts, and fee payments.

entries.name: Atlas CMMS
entries.description: Self-hosted Computerized Maintenance Management System. Allows teams to schedule work orders and manage inventory.

entries.name: FieldServiceScout
entries.description: Independent comparisons of field-service management software for trade shops, including features and modeled true cost.

entries.name: Anton
entries.description: Generative design framework for Blender leveraging topology optimization as a form-finding method.

entries.name: Design Explorer
entries.description: Web application for exploring multi-dimensional design spaces, used to visualize options from parametric studies.

entries.name: Ritn3D
entries.description: AI floor plan to 3D interior model converter. Auto-detects walls, doors, windows, and rooms from architectural PDFs (AutoCAD, Revit, ArchiCAD, SketchUp exports), scanned blueprints, or phone-camera photos; generates a walkable 3D interior in under 2 minutes with drag-and-drop furniture and GLB / STL export.

entries.name: FitsTheRoom
entries.description: Bathroom, half-bath, walk-in closet, laundry and reach-in closet layouts generated for an exact room size, drawn to scale and checked against IRC clearances (R307, P2708), with failing layouts shown alongside the fix. Its inch-by-inch bathroom size results are published as a CC0 dataset.

entries.name: ROS 2 (Robot Operating System)
entries.description: Open-source robotics middleware and toolkit, used in AEC to prototype construction robots and automation equipment.

entries.name: Gazebo Simulator
entries.description: High-fidelity 3D robotics simulator used to test construction robotics or automated equipment virtually.

entries.name: Open-RMF (Robotics Middleware Framework)
entries.description: Open-source framework for managing heterogeneous robot fleets and integrating them with building infrastructure such as elevators, automatic doors, workcells, and multi-floor facility maps.

entries.name: ros2_control
entries.description: Real-time hardware interface and controller framework for ROS 2, used to control actuators, robotic arms, and mobile bases in construction robotics and automated fabrication systems.

entries.name: DDC Skills Collection for AI Coding Assistants
entries.description: Collection of skills for AI coding assistants to automate construction workflows, including BIM analysis, cost estimation, scheduling, document processing, and reporting.

entries.name: IDS MCP Server
entries.description: Model Context Protocol server for creating, validating, and managing buildingSMART Information Delivery Specification (IDS) files.

entries.name: ARAI
entries.description: Browser-based AI engineering agent for architects and construction designers that works on the user's own DWG, DXF or PDF drawings from plain-language tasks. It explains drawing contents, calculates room areas into a schedule, edits drawings, publishes layouts as an ordered PDF drawing set, and answers building-code questions with document and clause references.

entries.name: AEC Pilot
entries.description: Add-in that runs a local MCP server inside Revit, AutoCAD, Civil 3D, Advance Steel, Navisworks, Inventor, Fusion, 3ds Max and Robot Structural Analysis, so Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP client can read and edit the open model. Commercial, with a 14-day free trial.

entries.name: P&ID to Knowledge Graph
entries.description: Claude Code skill and Python toolkit that extracts equipment, piping topology, ISA-5.1 instruments and control loops from digital or scanned P&ID and PFD PDFs into a DEXPI-aligned knowledge graph in JSON and DuckDB.

entries.name: Public Chemical Manufacturing Datasets
entries.description: Curated index of publicly downloadable P&ID and engineering drawing packages from permitted water and wastewater treatment facilities, alongside industrial process time-series datasets for testing engineering AI tools.

entries.name: Claude PFD Generator
entries.description: Claude skill that generates editable SVG process flow diagrams with equipment, process streams, instrumentation and control loops from plain-language process descriptions.

entries.name: UNION MCP BIM Server
entries.description: The MCP server built into UNION, a BIM and CAD drafting program: the guide, every command with its step line, the one-line ops, and 449 drafting jobs with their exact calls and UNION's answers, each played green on UNION 1.0.0-beta.2. UNION is commercial, with a free trial.

entries.name: ArchitecturesAI
entries.description: Browser-based AI rendering tool that turns a text prompt, sketch, floor plan or site photo into a photorealistic architectural render, with separate tools for interiors, exteriors, landscape and virtual staging. Freemium: one free render, then paid plans.

entries.name: DC Hub
entries.description: Orchestration layer for data center and energy intelligence, exposed as a remote MCP server that starts from an `execute_plan` tool for data center site selection questions. Covers data center and colocation facilities, power grid and interconnection queues, fiber, electricity prices and the Data Center Power Index (DCPI).

entries.name: cad2data
entries.description: Conversion pipeline and importers for turning Revit, IFC, DWG and DGN files into structured datasets (XLSX, CSV, DAE) for quantity takeoff, cost estimation and automated BIM workflows.

entries.name: QGIS MCP
entries.description: Model Context Protocol server connecting QGIS Desktop to AI agents for project and layer manipulation, processing algorithm execution and PyQGIS scripting.

entries.name: FreeCAD AI
entries.description: AI-powered workbench for FreeCAD providing Model Context Protocol integration and agentic 3D CAD modeling workflows.

entries.name: MCP4IFC
entries.description: Model Context Protocol server connecting large language models to IFC-based BIM authoring and editing in Blender through the Bonsai add-on and IfcOpenShell.

entries.name: OpenStudio MCP
entries.description: Model Context Protocol server and skills collection from NREL for creating, modifying and running OpenStudio building energy simulations via natural language.

entries.name: StructureClaw
entries.description: Open-source AI-assisted structural engineering workspace for drafting, analyzing, validating and code-checking structural models from natural-language prompts.

entries.name: ifcMCP
entries.description: Model Context Protocol server for querying IFC entities, properties, spatial hierarchy and wall openings from large language models.

entries.name: Speckle MCP
entries.description: Model Context Protocol server for listing projects, inspecting model versions and querying objects and properties in Speckle.

entries.name: APS AEC Data Model MCP
entries.description: Official Autodesk Platform Services .NET MCP server for querying the AEC Data Model API, filtering elements by category and rendering models in the Viewer.

entries.name: ifcopenshell-mcp
entries.description: Model Context Protocol server built on IfcOpenShell for querying, validating and converting IFC models through natural language.

entries.name: FreeCAD MCP
entries.description: Model Context Protocol server connecting FreeCAD to Claude and Cursor for prompt-assisted 3D CAD modeling and scene manipulation.

entries.name: Civil3D MCP
entries.description: Model Context Protocol server for Autodesk Civil 3D with tools for creating, querying and editing points, alignments, profiles, surfaces and corridors.

entries.name: Metashape MCP
entries.description: Model Context Protocol server for Agisoft Metashape Professional 2.3+ that automates photogrammetry pipelines from image alignment and dense point clouds to DEM and orthomosaic export.

entries.name: FEA-MCP
entries.description: Model Context Protocol server for structural finite element analysis software, supporting geometry modeling, analysis execution and post-processing in ETABS and LUSAS.

entries.name: idfkit-mcp
entries.description: Model Context Protocol server for inspecting, editing and running EnergyPlus building energy simulation models with idfkit.

entries.name: iTwin.js
entries.description: Open-source library from Bentley for creating and visualizing infrastructure digital twins.

entries.name: PlayCanvas
entries.description: Open-source WebGL game engine for building interactive 3D visualizations and digital twins.

entries.name: QGIS
entries.description: Free, open-source GIS for viewing, editing, and analyzing geospatial data.

entries.name: CesiumJS
entries.description: JavaScript library for 3D globes and map visualization, capable of streaming BIM data in a geospatial context.

entries.name: OpenLayers
entries.description: High-performance JS library for interactive maps on the web.

entries.name: BlenderGIS
entries.description: Blender addon to make the bridge between Blender's 3D data and 2D geographic data.

entries.name: Awesome GIS
entries.description: A curated list of GIS, remote sensing, 3D scanning, and other geospatial related sources.

entries.name: 3D City Database
entries.description: Free 3D geodatabase for storing and managing semantic 3D city models on a standard spatial relational database.

entries.name: CityJSON
entries.description: Specification and schemas for CityJSON, a JSON-based encoding of the CityGML data model for 3D city models.

entries.name: val3dity
entries.description: Validator for 3D primitives against the ISO 19107 standard, comparable to PostGIS ST_IsValid for 3D.

entries.name: mago 3DTiler
entries.description: Java tool that converts 3D formats such as OBJ, glTF, CityGML and IFC into OGC 3D Tiles for digital twin services.

entries.name: GRASS GIS
entries.description: GIS suite for geospatial data management, analysis, modeling and visualization.

entries.name: GeoServer
entries.description: Open-source server for sharing and editing geospatial data using OGC standards.

entries.name: PostGIS
entries.description: Spatial database extender for PostgreSQL.

entries.name: GDAL
entries.description: Translator library for raster and vector geospatial data formats.

entries.name: GeoPandas
entries.description: Python library for working with geospatial vector data, with geometry operations, spatial joins and mapping.

entries.name: GeoLibre
entries.description: Cloud-native GIS platform that runs in the browser, on desktop and mobile, and inside Jupyter notebooks.

entries.name: CloudCompare
entries.description: 3D point cloud and mesh processing software used for comparing and analyzing laser-scan survey data.

entries.name: PDAL
entries.description: Library for translating and processing point cloud data.

entries.name: Potree
entries.description: WebGL viewer for rendering very large point clouds in the browser.

entries.name: OpenDroneMap
entries.description: Open-source toolkit for processing drone imagery into orthophotos, elevation models, point clouds and 3D models.

entries.name: 3dfier
entries.description: Tool that turns 2D GIS datasets into 3D city models by lifting polygons to elevations taken from a point cloud.

entries.name: osgEarth
entries.description: C++ SDK for building geospatially accurate 3D maps and terrain rendering into applications.

entries.name: TerriaJS
entries.description: Library for building web-based 2D and 3D geospatial data explorers, used for national and state digital twin platforms.

entries.name: OSMnx
entries.description: Python package for downloading, modeling, analyzing and visualizing street networks and other geospatial features from OpenStreetMap.

entries.name: UrbanSim
entries.description: Platform for building statistical models of cities and regions to support urban and land-use planning.

entries.name: Entwine
entries.description: Data organization library for indexing very large point clouds so they can be streamed and visualized.

entries.name: pgPointcloud
entries.description: PostgreSQL extension for storing and querying LiDAR point cloud data.

entries.name: Mini5Planner
entries.description: Desktop app for macOS and Windows that plans single and double grid photogrammetry flights for DJI Fly drones and exports them as WPML KMZ missions, used for site, excavation and stockpile surveys. Free to use; an optional paid Pro license adds terrain following and battery splitting.

entries.name: OpenProject
entries.description: Collaborative project management tool with Gantt charts, Agile workflows, and BIM integration.

entries.name: LibrePlan
entries.description: Resource planning and scheduling software for construction projects.

entries.name: BidWright
entries.description: Open-source AI-native construction estimating: 2D/3D takeoff, assemblies, pricing, scheduling, and quotes.

entries.name: Simulateur Prix Construction Maison
entries.description: Free French-market construction cost estimator. Estimates building prices per m² based on 36 criteria and 25 budget categories (structural work, roofing, insulation, plumbing, etc.).

entries.name: Concrete Estimator Hub Calculators
entries.description: Browser-based and WordPress-embeddable concrete planning calculators for slabs, bags, ready-mix comparison, and job worksheets.

entries.name: OpenConstructionERP
entries.description: Self-hosted construction ERP with BOQ and cost databases, PDF/CAD/BIM quantity takeoff, estimating, and 4D/5D scheduling.

entries.name: OpenTakeoff
entries.description: Open-source PDF takeoff tool for measuring quantities off construction drawings, usable from a browser canvas or driven by AI agents through an MCP server.

entries.name: debim
entries.description: Declarative BIM engine and Building-as-Code compiler that calculates material quantities, generates cost estimates from price catalogs, compiles to IFC4, and produces standalone 3D HTML viewers.

entries.name: Concrete Mix AI
entries.description: Free concrete quantity takeoff from PDF or DWG plans (concrete, rebar, and CMU), with each quantity traced to the drawing. No account required.

entries.name: Level Commercial Building Value & Trade Expenditure Calculator
entries.description: Calculates annual commercial building maintenance and trade-service expenditure across 51 US states/DC, 11 commercial property types, and 7 trades using 9,084,887 commercial property records, CBECS/BOMA/IFMA benchmarks, and a read-only MCP server.

entries.name: EstimatorSuite
entries.description: Free construction calculator library and estimating software reviews for US contractors. Covers concrete, roofing, HVAC, drywall, decking, fencing, and landscaping; the calculation engine is MIT-licensed.

entries.name: Alsaba Cloud BOQ Pricing
entries.description: Web tool that prices an uploaded bill of quantities (Excel or PDF) line by line for the Saudi market and returns a priced workbook; rates without a library price are marked as preliminary estimates. Arabic and English, with a free tier.
